do_not_merge: Resource dispatch and caller receipt/feedback protocols differ while the actual three resource algorithms are already shared. Do not add RewardManager or a universal return structure merely to remove a few switch branches.
Shop sampling draws rarity then item (two RNG draws per slot); ItemV5Pool uses one normalized weighted draw per item. Combining these would alter random streams/manifests.
Defense actives use ready_at/map_uses and different receipt/resource rules; only projectile actives and G05 share cooldown_until/cast_sequence submission.
B16/G10 already share _kill_bonus; their award-count budget differs from B20 total-map-coin cap.
Run/Meta currency, reward offer receipts, purchase receipts and item source receipts represent different authority and must not be replaced by a second global ledger.
preexisting_defects_not_fixed: ItemRuntime.patch_state writes owned broken state before refresh; a rejected refresh does not restore that state.
Paid active casts retain the original behavior where a refused subsequent progress patch does not refund/reject the paid cast.
